visualCharacteristics: Background video hero: autoplay, muted, looping mp4 behind a dark overlay with poster fallback; H1, subtext and green pill CTA bottom-left; pause/play toggle bottom-right.
contentPattern: Hero with autoplay background video, H1 'Design an exterior you'll love coming home to', subtext, CTA 'Start your design', pause button
usage: Top-of-page hero with a looping muted background video over a poster image, a heading, short subtext and one CTA.
reuseGuidance: Use when the hero media is a video. For a still image hero use hero. Without a video link it renders as an image hero.
structure: Row 1: poster picture and a link to the .mp4 video file
Row 2: H1, subheading paragraph, CTA link
